seoTitle: Riverdale Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Riverdale test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Archie, Betty, Veronica, Jughead, Cheryl, Toni, Reggie or Hiram — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the hero, the girl next door with a dark side, or the queen bee? Answer 12 everyday questions about loyalty, secrets and small-town drama, and find out which Riverdale character you are.

characters.name: Archie Andrews
characters.title: The Hero
characters.summary: Earnest, loyal and always trying to save the day. You throw yourself into everything with your whole heart.
description: Like Archie, you wear your heart on your sleeve. He's torn between football and music, and between what everyone wants for him and what he wants for himself.
You try to fix everything. Archie can't walk away when someone needs help, even when it gets him into serious trouble.
You keep reinventing yourself. Over the years, Archie becomes a boxer, then a contractor and an amateur writer.
characters.flaw: You charge in to save everyone before you've thought it through.
characters.signature: Red hair, a guitar and a serious hero complex.
characters.clashReason: they'd try to fix your problems for you, whether you asked or not

characters.name: Betty Cooper
characters.title: The Girl Next Door, With a Dark Side
characters.summary: Sweet, smart and driven, with a darker side nobody sees coming. You won't stop until you've found the truth.
description: Like Betty, you seem like the perfect girl next door. She's sweet, studious and eager to please.
You're a natural detective. Betty can't leave a mystery alone, and she grows up to work as an investigator.
But there's more to you than people think. Betty has a dark side she fights to control, and she's been pushed into situations nobody should ever face.
characters.flaw: You hold everything in until it explodes.
characters.signature: A high ponytail, a notebook full of clues and a darker side than anyone guesses.
characters.clashReason: they'd investigate you without telling you

characters.name: Veronica Lodge
characters.title: The Heiress
characters.summary: Glamorous, sharp and braver than people expect. You were born rich, but you're determined to be better.
description: Like Veronica, you've got style and confidence to spare. She moves to Riverdale from New York after her father's arrest.
You're trying to be better. Veronica used to be a New York mean girl, and she's determined not to be that person any more.
You stand up for what's right, even against your own family. Veronica eventually turns against her father, Hiram.
characters.flaw: You can't resist the drama, even when you swear you're done with it.
characters.signature: Pearls, a cocktail dress and a business plan.

characters.name: Jughead Jones
characters.title: The Outsider
characters.summary: Brooding, sarcastic and always on the outside looking in. You notice everything, and you write it all down.
description: Like Jughead, you're happiest on the outside. He's a writer and the editor of the school newspaper.
You find your own people. After his father's arrest, Jughead joins the Southside Serpents.
You see the story in everything. Jughead narrates the show, and almost nothing gets past him.
characters.flaw: You assume the worst about people before they've had a chance.
characters.signature: A crown-shaped beanie, a laptop and a booth at Pop's.
characters.clashReason: they'd make a sarcastic comment about everything you love

characters.name: Cheryl Blossom
characters.title: The Queen Bee
characters.summary: Dramatic, icy and absolutely fabulous. You hide your heart behind a perfect entrance.
description: Like Cheryl, you rule the room. She's Riverdale High's queen bee and head cheerleader.
You're tougher than anyone knows. Behind Cheryl's icy exterior is a painful family life she's had to survive.
You become yourself. Over time, Cheryl embraces who she really is, and finds love with Toni.
characters.flaw: You'd rather make a scene than admit you're hurt.
characters.signature: Red lipstick, a red outfit and a dramatic exit line.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn every disagreement into a performance

characters.name: Toni Topaz
characters.title: The Cool Rebel
characters.summary: Laid-back, loyal and nobody's fool. You don't need drama to make your point.
description: Like Toni, you're effortlessly cool. She's a photographer for the school newspaper, and she comes from one of the founding families of the Southside Serpents.
You're loyal to your people. Toni stands by the Serpents, and by the people she loves.
You take charge when it counts. Toni eventually becomes the leader of the Serpents.
characters.flaw: You keep your guard up so high that people think you don't care.
characters.signature: A camera, a Serpent jacket and pink hair.
characters.clashReason: they'd shrug off something that really matters to you

characters.name: Reggie Mantle
characters.title: The Rival
characters.summary: Cocky, competitive and always up for a laugh. You love a rivalry, and you love winning it even more.
description: Like Reggie, you're never short of confidence. He's a football player, and Archie's longtime friend and rival.
You love a good prank. Reggie is the town's biggest joker, and nobody is safe.
But you're more loyal than you look. Under all the swagger, Reggie has stuck with Archie for years.
characters.flaw: You'd rather win than be right.
characters.signature: A letterman jacket, a smirk and a prank already in motion.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn everything into a competition, then gloat

characters.name: Hiram Lodge
characters.title: The Kingpin
characters.summary: Charming, calculating and always in control. You build empires, and you don't care who gets crushed.
description: Like Hiram, you think big. He's Veronica's father, a wealthy CEO with a polished public image.
But you play by your own rules. Behind the charm, Hiram is a crime boss who keeps running his empire, even from prison.
You never let go of control. Hiram wants to own Riverdale, and he'll use anyone, even his own daughter, to do it.
characters.flaw: You'd sacrifice anyone, even family, to stay in control.
characters.signature: A tailored suit, a cold smile and half the town in your pocket.
characters.clashReason: they'd buy everything you love, just to prove they could

questions.text: Your town is throwing a big summer festival. You...

options.text: Sign up to play a song on the main stage
Make an entrance so dramatic nobody remembers the festival
Write a scathing piece about what the festival is really covering up
Quietly fund the whole thing. Now the town is in your debt

questions.text: A friend is clearly hiding something from you. You...

options.text: Quietly piece it together from the clues
Leave it. They'll tell you when they're ready
Take them out for a fancy dinner and get it out of them
Tease them about it until they crack

questions.text: Someone at school is being bullied. You...

options.text: Step in, even if it means a fight
Stand next to them, so they know they're not alone
Humiliate the bully in public. They'll never try it again
Laugh along at first, then feel bad about it later
Start a business. You've always had a head for it
Take any job going, even the back-breaking ones
Call in a favour from someone who owes you
Get by on almost nothing. You've done it before

questions.text: Someone powerful has done you wrong. You...

options.text: Dig up everything on them, and expose it all
Use your own connections to beat them at their own game
Rally the outcasts and take them on together
Plot an elaborate, theatrical revenge

questions.text: It's your turn to host the end-of-year party the whole town will be talking about. You...

options.text: Make it black tie, with a theme people will talk about for years
Make sure there's a prank nobody will ever forget
Plan everything, right down to the snacks
Turn it into a business opportunity
Go straight to your best friend's house and talk it all out
Get dressed up and go somewhere fabulous. Their loss
Make sure everyone knows they'll regret it
Shrug it off. You've got bigger things going on

questions.text: Your family asks you to keep a dark secret. You...

options.text: Keep it, but it eats away at you
Of course. Family secrets are what keep a family on top
Go along with it, until it hurts someone you love. Then all bets are off
Say nothing, and trust nobody with it

questions.text: Someone challenges you to a competition. You...

options.text: Accept, and talk trash the whole way through
Accept, and train harder than you've ever trained
Only if it's worth your time
Make sure you've won before it even starts

questions.text: Your crush starts dating your best friend. You...

options.text: Smile, say you're happy for them, and quietly fall apart
Find someone new by Friday
Throw a fit worthy of an awards show, then date someone even better
Be honest with both of them, then move on

questions.text: You live in a small town where something dark happens every week. You...

options.text: Start investigating before the police do
Narrate the whole thing like it's a novel
Try to fix it all yourself, one problem at a time
Work out how to profit from it

questions.text: You're in a gang, and your leader wants you to do something you think is wrong. You...

options.text: Refuse. Then take over the gang yourself
Question it out loud, even if it costs you
Do it, but make it look like someone else's idea
Strike a deal that gets everyone what they want
